links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRES) of LLM-generated ankylosing spondylitis patient education responses
links.effect: FKGL ranged 15.33-15.93 across models, requiring university-level reading skills; FRES highest for DeepSeek V3 (14.93) and lowest for ChatGPT-3.5 (5.29).
links.quote: FKGL scores varied within a narrow range (15.33-15.93) across models.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated patient materials versus patient literacy
links.effect: FKGL 15.33-15.93 across four LLMs, interpreted as requiring university-level reading skills; too complex for most patients.
links.quote: Therefore, it was interpreted that the data required university-level reading skills.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM-generated patient education materials for ankylosing spondylitis using standard quality (DISCERN) and readability metrics without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
